headline: Tiger Brands Shares Jump Over 11% Following Annual Results Release
summary: Tiger Brands shares jumped more than 11% on its results day as executives addressed socioeconomic challenges and consumer inflation pressures.
why: Consumer goods companies provide insight into domestic household spending power and resilience against inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Tiger Brands Ltd
impacts.why: Positive market reception to financial results drives share price appreciation.
